# 0x0800 SRL |Denis Leclercq

> Cloud & AI Infrastructure Advisor | NIS2, Private AI, FinOps, Sovereign Cloud

## About

Denis Leclercq is a Cloud & AI Infrastructure Advisor based in Liège, Belgium, operating through 0x0800 SRL (BCE: BE1021845609). He advises DSI, CTO and engineering teams on resilient sovereign architectures, NIS2/ISO27001 compliance, Cloud Drift remediation, and Private AI deployment.

## Services

- NIS2 Compliance Audit: Infrastructure audit with continuous compliance verification via IaC and Drift Detection.
- Cloud Drift Detection & Remediation: Mapping gaps between IaC (Terraform) and actual cloud state (AWS, Azure, OVH). Remediation plan in 10 days.
- Private AI Deployment: On-premise/VPC LLM deployment so teams can use AI without exposing data to public APIs.
- FinOps Optimization: Cloud cost control in a context of energy inflation and budget pressure.
- Sovereign Cloud Architecture: Multi-cloud/sovereign cloud architectures decoupled from geopolitical risks.

## Expertise

20 years of infrastructure experience, from bare-metal server rooms to cloud-native architectures. AWS, Azure, OVH, Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevSecOps.
